title: Question
description: Schema for a single question entry in the FullStackMastery Question Bank.

question_id.description: Unique stable identifier for the question. Used as the join key with answers.json. Format: Q_<DOMAIN>_<CONCEPT>.

domain_id.description: The technical domain this question belongs to.

question.description: The full question text shown to the user.

primary_slide_id.description: Optional. Reference to the source slide/lesson this question originates from.

category.description: The sub-category or topic within the domain. Resolved to a Category slug in the database.

tags.description: Optional. List of tag slugs for cross-feature filtering (e.g. role, technology, concept).

related_concepts.description: Optional. List of related concept IDs or labels.

related_questions.description: Optional. List of related question_ids that users should explore after this one.
